_comment: Hand-kept categories for tools/unsent_messages.py: id -> [category, note]. Categories: needed, optional, variant, debug, content, no-op, blocked, unknown.

0x1b1: item back from the crafting inventory {handle, container, slot}; this server never moves items into a crafting inventory (docs/CRAFTING.md)
0x1b2: crafting-inventory item used up {handle}; same as 0x1b1
0x1b8: item equipped {handle, u8, u8}; the server resends the whole item record (0x197) instead
0x1b9: item equip {3 x i32}; the server resends the item record instead
0x1ba: item unequip {3 x i32}; the server resends the item record instead
0x1c2: item conversion window ("Convert %i x %s to:"); needs conversion recipes
0x1c3: u8; handler not decoded (near the conversion messages)
0x1c5: item use failure code {u8}, e.g. 0x16 "You need to wield a harvesting tool"; the server words failures as text today
0x1d2: pet graft added; pet grafts are content (docs/PETS.md)
0x1d5: MsgSingleItemInfo into another container; the server uses 0x197 and the container-specific messages
0x1da: sets an item's +0x668 flag {handle, bool} (docs/ITEM_FIELDS.md); the server resends the record
0x1dc: item base data update (damage, AC, level); the server resends the record
0x1dd: item mod (MsgItemMod); item modifications are content
0x1de: item attachment slot (MsgItemAttachSlot); attachments are content
0x1e1: vehicle name field (_inventory_name_vehicle); vehicles (boats) are content
0x1e3: "%s has been bound to you..." {handle}: sent when a Bind On Equip item is worn (2026-10-14)
0x1e4: unique item add failure; Unique items are not enforced yet
0x1e5: eid64, i32, i32; handler not decoded
0x5e4: "%s has been unbound from you..." {handle}: sent by the Unbinding Tool (verified live 2026-10-14)
0x5e6: Gold Membership unlock; this server has no membership locks
0x82e: item avatar info {i32, wstr}; handler not decoded
0x118: class display flags {3 x i32} (ClassShowsSpellDamage / HealingBonus) for the character sheet
0x119: adventuring / crafting / diplomacy levels {3 x i32} (nAdvLevelSelf...); levels reach the client through MsgScore today
0x272: raid lockout share offer (Accept / Decline -> /lockoutaccept 0x273); no raid lockouts here
0x31b: strDiplomatRankSelf {wstr}: the diplomat rank title on the character sheet
0x3ec: Infamy {i32} (PvP); no PvP on this server
0x44b: wounds {5 x u8} (bIsWounded per body part); no wound system yet
0x508: petition submit window {wstr, i32}; petitions go to the GM queue in the original
0x552: bInOutpost {bool8}: outpost flag (the camp is an outpost); what it unlocks is not known
0x723: "You lost a level, your %s level is now %d." {sphere, level}; this server never takes levels away
0x726: trial-account feature popup (mail, housing...); never send
0x75d: MsgSingleItemInfo in the player dispatcher; purpose not decoded
